shared_tail.surface: عبد الرحمن بن عبد الله بن أبي عمار

notes: «يعني ابن أصرم» after خشيش is an editor gloss and is left out.
Both branches meet at ابن جريج, each writing its own name for him; the names after the second ابن جريج are written once and form the shared tail.
Ya'la is the last link: his words to Umar are the saying.
